name: Asynchronous Unhandled Promise Rejection Crashing Headless Runner
description: Analytics tracking pixel call rejected asynchronously after test completed, causing Node.js process exit code 1 with UnhandledPromiseRejection.

failure_vector.broken_code: await page.goto('/checkout'); await page.click('#confirm-checkout-btn'); // Missing unhandledrejection listener
failure_vector.error_log: UnhandledPromiseRejection: This error originated either by throwing inside of an async function without a catch block, or by rejecting a promise which was not handled with .catch().

expected_resolution.healed_code: page.on('pageerror', err => { if (!err.message.includes('analytics')) throw err; }); await page.goto('/checkout'); await page.click('#confirm-checkout-btn');
